description: Piezoelectric floor: a row of PZT tiles wired to a common CU bus, converting footstep/impact pressure into SPRK pulses.
name: piezo_floor_pzt
why: PZT's piezo behaviour fires when mechanical stress exceeds its threshold (5.0), pulsing every 2 frames while stressed -- wire a walkway or hatch of these tiles into a CU bus to harvest foot traffic or impacts as a real energy-harvesting floor. Curie point is only 360 C (transitions to BMTL) so this is a cool-running mechanical sensor/harvester, not something to put anywhere near a hot process.
